chunks: And We destroyed the generations before you when they were unjust, and their messengers had come to them with clear proofs, yet they were not to believe. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.

key_terms.الْقُرُونَ: Generations or communities of the past
key_terms.ظَلَمُوا: They were unjust or wronged themselves

ai.seo_question: Why did God destroy the previous generations according to Surah Yunus?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the 'fate of the disbelievers' (sunan Allah) by linking the destruction of past nations to their specific injustice (zulm) and stubborn rejection of clear proofs (bayinat) brought by prophets. It serves as a warning to the contemporaries of Prophet Muhammad (PBUH) that divine retribution is not merely punitive but a just recompense for persistent criminality and denial of truth.
